newsitem.title: UK: Royal&Sun confirms 98 mln stg Prosure sale.
newsitem.headline: Royal&Sun confirms 98 mln stg Prosure sale.

text.p: Royal & Sun Alliance, Britain's recently merged composite insurer, confirmed on Friday it is to sell its majority 77.8 percent stake in South African insurer Prosure to two other insurance companies, Mutual & Federal and Commercial Union.
Royal & Sun gains 98 million stg from the sale, which involves selling the general business to Mutual & Federal and the life and investment management arms to Commercial Union of South Africa.

The transaction is the first significant restructuring move except for staff cuts since the 5.4 billion stg merger in July of Royal Insurance and Sun Alliance, who before the deal were fierce rivals in a highly competitive market.
Prosure announced the sale in South Africa on Thursday.
